'''Kaiza''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] who worked aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], selling rare artifacts and gifts.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kaiza appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as the Curator vendor on Vaiken Spacedock.<ref name="TOR" />
